summary.tagline: Saltfjorden (Norwegian) or Sáltovuodna (Lule Sami) is a fjord in Bodø Municipality and Gildeskål Municipality

days.title: Tidal Straits and Central Islands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Saltstraumen
stops.detail: The outer part of the fjord is connected to its inner part via the three straits Saltstraumen, Godøystraumen and Sundstraumen.

stops.name: Knaplundsøya
stops.detail: Between this connection lie the two islands Knaplundsøya (Godøya) and Straumøya.

stops.name: Sandhornøya
stops.detail: In addition to these two islands, there is the island of Sandhornøya at the mouth of the fjord in the southern area and a number of smaller islands in front of Sandhornøya as well as in front of the Bodø peninsula.

stops.name: Tennholmen fyr
stops.detail: The Tennholmen fyr lighthouse is located in the outer area of the fjord.
